implementation_statement: Compensating control (one-person business): the owner-operator holds every duty, so duties cannot be separated. Checks that do not depend on the owner's controls carry the load. The certified laboratory analyzes the compliance samples and reports results to the state. The daily grab sample is independent of the PLC, and the metering pump's stroke-length setting caps maximum feed. The integrator's portal account is to stay disabled except for sessions the owner approves and records in the maintenance log (POL-01 6.2). Gap: the integrator's account is always enabled, and the relief operator signs in with the owner's login (POAM-002, POAM-004).
regulatory_driver: C-WATER-R01 (300i-2(a)(1)(A)(ii) automated systems; voluntary benchmark below 3,300); 40 CFR 141.404(c) (4-log treatment)

implementation_statement: Compensating control (one-person business): the owner-operator designed, operates, and assessed the controls, and P07 states that independence is limited. The IT technician ran the external router check under a confidentiality agreement but also supports the laptop. POL-01 4.5 requires an outside reviewer at least every second year, such as the IT technician or an EPA-sponsored assessment if one is available to a system this size. The portal vendor's SOC 2 report (P09) covers inherited controls. Base CA-2 is the July self-assessment.
regulatory_driver: C-WATER-R01 (300i-2(a)(1)(A)(ii) automated systems; voluntary benchmark below 3,300)

implementation_statement: Compensating control (one-person business): there is no change board, so under CM-3(g) the owner's approval and the maintenance log are the change control element. Integrator sessions need the owner's approval and are logged with the changes made (POL-01 6.2). After any PLC program or HMI change the owner makes a new owner-held copy and checks the dose and pump settings against the manual-operation sheet the same day (POL-01 6.3). The portal records every setpoint change. Gap: the integrator signed in 3 times in 90 days and only 1 matched a support call (POAM-002).
evidence: POL-01 6.2 and 6.3; maintenance log; portal audit log; POAM-002
regulatory_driver: C-WATER-R01 (300i-2(a)(1)(A)(ii) automated systems; voluntary benchmark below 3,300); 40 CFR 141.404(c) (4-log treatment)
